chunks: Those who disbelieve after their faith, then increase in disbelief, their repentance will not be accepted, and those are the ones who have gone astray.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people whose repentance will not be accepted according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from mere nominal belief to entrenched disbelief, where the heart becomes sealed due to persistent rejection of truth. The condition of 'not accepting repentance' is understood by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni as applying to those who die in this state of increased kufr, emphasizing the finality of their spiritual deviation. This serves as a warning against complacency in faith and the danger of hardening one's heart after initial acceptance.
